title: Aggregate renderer build report
description: Shape of the report written to output.reportPath. The publish workflow consumes this file, so every field named here is settled and no field may be renamed without a workflow change.

exitCode.description: Equal to the process exit code. 0 all projects complete, 1 at least one project partial or failed, 2 blocked before rendering.

links.description: How many hrefs of each kind the build resolved, over the whole run.

documents.description: Hrefs rewritten through the router to a published document.

unresolved.description: Hrefs naming a document the build did not publish. Left as written.

absolute.description: Root absolute hrefs, already in published form, left unverified.

external.description: Hrefs naming another scheme or host, left untouched.

anchors.description: Fragments of the page itself, left untouched.

non-document-link.description: Hrefs that do not name a markdown document, such as a link to an image or an archive.

projects.description: One entry per discovered project, ordered by slug.

slug.description: Site path of the project: repository name, lowercased, separators collapsed to a single hyphen.

versions.description: Versions published for this project, ordered by version segment.

pages.description: Pages rendered for this project. Zero when the project status is failed or skipped.

errors.description: Reasons recorded for this project, ordered by reasonCode.

message.description: Human-readable detail naming the file, key or page at fault. Never contains a token.
